tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar can gyi chog khrigs 'khrul med go sla'i ngag 'don bkod pa bzhugs so// rnam 'dren dbang po'i thugs rje'i gtsug 'khrungs ma/ /de dang gnyis med bla ma dam pa'i zhabs/ /rtsibs stong re mos mdzes pa deng nas bzung / /nam zhig rnam mkhyen bar du bdag spyir 'jog /'dir gtsug tor gdugs dkar can gyi chog khrigs 'khrul med go sla'i ngag 'don bkod par bdag dang gzhan gyi don sgrub par 'dod pas/ dus bzang po la khrus byas gso sbyong blang / dkyil 'khor byed pa'i sa phyogs der sa lha gtor ma byin nas/ sa sbyang gzung spyi dang mthun par bya ba nyid la/ so thar gyi sdom pa dge bsnyen yan gang rung dang ldan pas theg pa chen po'i byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / 'di'i dkyil 'khor ram/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur ba thob la ma nyams pa sngon du bsnyen pa dang / dkyil 'khor las rim gnyis kyi dang po ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bdag bskyed bsgom ste/ ma mtha' bsnyen sngags khri phrag gcig bcu cha sbyin sreg dang bcas pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor las rim la rang gi mdun du cog tse'i khar rang gi g.yon du rdo rje/ g.yas su dril bu zhal rang la bstan pa de dag gi phyir/ rang gi g.yon nas 'go byas nyer spyod dang / de nyid dam nye logs su stegs gzhan zhig gi khar/ yungs chu/ thal ba/ ba byung / dri bzang gi chu rnams bkod/ gzhan yang phur bu bcu tho bcas/ yungs dkar gyi chun po/ gu gul sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams sta gon byas te/ kha cig gso sbyong len pa'i skabs su/ rten khyim pa yin na blang dgos kyi/ dge slong dge tshul gyis len mi dgos gsung zer te gsungs pa mi bden las che/ bden srid na sdom pa len pa'i go rim gyi rnam bzhag ma chags pa yin te/ dge bsnyen la srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa yod kyang /

dge tshul gyi bslab pa len pa na srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa blang dgos la/ de ni dge slong byed pa na yang srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa blang dgos pa bzhin/ dge slong bzang po byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa len pa na sngar mi dge ba spong ba'i sdom pa yod kyang / yang mi dge ba spong ba'i sdom pa len pa'i phyir dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom ldan gsang sngags kyi sgor 'jug pa na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed blang dgos shing / dge sbyor gyi thun re'i 'go la yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya dgos pa'i phyir dang / yo ga ba dang / rnal 'byor bla med pa rnams sngar gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dus su/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa thob la ma nyams pa yod kyang / mngon rtogs tshar re'i 'gor yang rigs lnga'i sdom gzung bya dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes don zhags yid ches khungs btsun du gsungs pas gso sbyong nges par blangs dgos pas/ tho rangs snga bar khrus byas nas langs la/ ༈ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu rgya bya/ dngos su phyag 'tshal zhing / gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i/

/zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing / /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /skur gyur pa ni thams cad la/ /mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa/ /rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can/ /zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan/ /phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ /gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gzhan gyis mi thub la sogs pa/ /sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ /bdag nyid gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdung bdun de bzhin gshegs pa bcu/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams dang / /drang srong rig 'dzin grub rnams la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan pa srung mdzad bgegs dpung 'joms/ /gzhan gyis mi thub stobs po che/ /legs nyes btang 'dzin dam tshig can/ /legs ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha dog ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /mthu dang sde dang bzhon par bcas/ /thabs dang snying rjes 'jig rten kun/ /skyong mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis/ /lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed su dag nas/ byang chub chen por bsngo/ /tsog pur thal mo sbyar la/ phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/

yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can/ de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir gso sbyong gi sdom pa nges par yang dag par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di rig pa 'dzin pa zhes gsung rgyun no/ /zhes bgyis bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong gi sdom pa nges par yang dag pa blang bar bgyi ba'o/ /deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyod cing / /rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer brten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri stan mthon po mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed pa/ /de ltar srog gcod la sogs spang / /bla med byang chub thob par shog /sdug bsngal mang 'khrugs 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ oṃ a mo gha shī la/ sam+bha ra/ sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shud+dha satwa/ pad+ma bi bhu ṣi ta bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/

sa man+ta a wa lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nyer gcig dang / a na le/ nyer gcig bzlas/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /badz+ra muḥ bsdu rgya phyir bstan bya/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ dpung bzang las gso sbyong gi sdom pa dang ldan pas las la 'jug par bshad cing dkyil chog 'di dang nam mkha'i mtshan can gyi gzungs grwa lnga'i zin bris su gso sbyong thog mar bya ba bshad pa sogs kyi dgongs pa bzhin bris so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bri bar 'gyur ba'i sar sa brtags pa dang snang ba las blang ba dang gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin mi snang ba la blang ba/ dkar gtor gcig la chab bran/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ gsum/ yul grong gnas gzhi'i bdag po sa pa ri wā ra ar+ṣā ya dzaḥ lcags kyu'i rgya/ pad skor sngon 'gro'i rdo thal kha phye/ oṃ yul bdag grong bdag gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa sarba sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na twata/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ so so'i rgya/ oṃ badz+ra dhūp+pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wid+ya hūm̐/ dril bu dkrol zhing / gang spros bcas/ yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am ni gzhan/ /de dag rnams la sa 'di ni/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis bstsal du gsol/ /gsum/ ar+ghaṃ mchod yon rgya/ swā hā/ sarba sar+tha se gol/ naṃ gats+tsha/ de nas a mṛ ta bzla zhing / yungs chu/ thal ba/ ba byung / dri bzang rnams kyis sa gzhi la dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du byug

sa gzhi'i dbus su skyil krung gis 'dug sa gnon gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ sa gzhi stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ a na le/ bdun/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor chen mo bri bar bya'o/ /zhes brjod/ oṃ dus gsum bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku/ /gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che/ /gtum mo chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid can/ /dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba gos dkar mo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ /rgyal ba'i rdo rje phreng zhes grags/ /pad+ma'i mngon mtshan rdo rje'i mtshan/ /gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can/ /rdo rje'i mkhar rnams 'joms pa mo/ /zhi ba lha rnams kyis mchod ma/ /gzugs zhi gzi brjid chen mo can/ /'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo/ /rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud gzhan dang / /rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin ma/ /lag na rdo rje rig ser phreng / /le brgan rtsi dang rin chen ma/ /snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags/ /rnam par 'gying ma'i rdo rje dang / /gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma/ /rdo rje 'gros dang dkar mo dang / /pad+ma'i spyan dang zla 'od dang / /phyag rgya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis/ /sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum gyi bar gong gi sa lha bzhin/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsar+b+ba tad khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā/ thal mo sbyar la sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/

/'jig rten na dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la༞ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la༞ 'jig rten na yang dag par song ba rnams la༞ yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la༞ lha'i drang srong dmod pa 'dor ba dang phan 'dogs nus pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan drag po dka' thub bzlog pa'i bdag po lhan cig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan nag po chen po grong 'khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed pa dur khrod na gnas par mos pa ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin po che'i rigs nor bu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las kyi rigs glang po'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma'i rigs gzhon nu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i rigs klu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das 'gre/ 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sman gyi bla zer ba 'di ma dag te/ rgya dpe la gu ru baiḍūr+ya zhes so/ /bod skad du slob dpon gsum/ sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa la'i dbang po me tog kun tu rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin po che tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan rgyas pa ut+pa la'i bsung gi tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/

/de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba phyir bzlog pa chen mo 'dis 'byung po'i gdon thams cad tshar gcod pa/ gzhan gyi rig sngags gcod pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba las bzlog pa/ sems can bcings pa thams cad 'grol ba/ sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad bzlog pa/ gdon brgyad khri bzhi stong 'jigs par byed pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' bar byed pa/ gza' chen po brgyad 'jigs par byed pa/ dgra thams cad bzlog pa/ ma rung pa dang / sdang ba dang / rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ dug dang / mtshon dang / me dang / chu las sgrol ba ste/ rig sngags kyi cho ga 'di sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la rig sngags 'di 'grub par gyur cig swā hā/ khyab byed kyi gdon gyi rigs 'byung po'i tshogs gang su dag sa la rgyu ba rnams dang / lha'i gdon nam mkha' la rgyu ba rnams dang / dud 'gro'i gdon chu la༞ lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / lha ma yin 'thab rtsod kyi gdon/ rnams༞ rlung lha rig sngags 'chang nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ nam mkha' lding bya khyung dri za rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs/ mi'am ci/ lto 'phyo chen po sa bdag lto 'phye/ gnod sbyin ri rab khong gseng nas/ srin po sha za rnams/ yi dwags/ sha za nag mo bcu gcig 'byung po/ grul bum gshin rje dang ma mo tshad mo/ srul po/ lus srul po/ skem byed skam mdze'i rigs/ smyo byed/ grib gnon kho'i grib ma song 'dus ma ju/ brjed byed snying mi dran rmugs byed/ gnon 'on byed/ skul nas sa bon smin byed/ po rnams bdag la nyon cig 'byung po'i tshogs gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams dang / mdangs 'phrog pa༞

zas su mngal za ba mu stegs kyi sma gshed kyi/ zas su khrag za ba dus thams cad du/ zas su zhag za ba srin mo bzhi'o/ /zas su sha za ba gnod sbyin srin po/ zas su tshil za ba mig log pa'i/ zas su rkang za ba bcud thams cad za ba/ zas su btsas pa za ba skyes ma thag tu shi ba/ zas su srog 'phrog pa dbugs za ba/ zas su gtor ma za ba bsngos pas tshim pa/ zas su phreng ba za ba me tog gi zas su dri za ba tsan dan/ zas su bdug pa za ba rlangs pa za ba/ zas su me tog za ba phreng ba ma yin pa/ zas su 'bras bu za ba shing tog zas su lo tog za ba rnams dang phye za ba/ zas su sbyin sreg za ba byang chen snying po rgyud chen nas las dngos sbyin sreg byas pa zhes kyi bya ba gsungs so/ /zas su rnag za ba gling bar gyi mun nag na gnas so/ /zas su phyi sa za ba/ zas su gcin 'thung ba/ zas su lhag ma za ba/ zas su mchil ma 'thung ba/ zas su snabs za ba/ zas su ngar snabs za ba/ zas su mi gtsang ba za ba/ zas su skyug pa za ba/ zas su gtor khung nas bab pa 'thung ba/ khu ba dang bshal chu/ sdig lus ngag yid gsum mi dge ba bcu spyad/ pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams bdag la nyon cig rig sngags chen mo 'di bsgrub par bya'o/ /spos dang me tog dang bdug pa dang gtor ma yang sbyin no/ /gtor ma dang mchod pa 'dis mgu bar gyis la/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams/ gzi brjid 'phrog pa'i gdon thams cad dengs shig

ces brjod la rol mo drag po bya'o/ /gtor ma phyir dor phyag rdor rtsa sngags dang thams cad 'joms pa'i brtan bzlas/ de nas mtshams bcad par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma chen mo'i bkas ming 'di zhes bya ba la bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la zhes 'og ma kun la 'gre/ sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / lha'i gdon rnams dang rnams dang zhes 'og ma kun la 'gre/ klu'i gdon༞ lha ma yin gyi gdon༞ rlung lha'i gdon༞ nam mkha' lding gi gdon༞ dri za'i gdon༞ mi'am ci'i gdon༞ lto 'phye chen po'i gdon༞ gnod sbyin gyi gdon༞ srin po'i gdon༞ yi dwags kyi gdon༞ sha za'i gdon༞ 'byung po'i gdon༞ grul bum gyi gdon༞ srul po'i gdon༞ lus srul po'i gdon༞ skem byed kyi gdon༞ sha ba'i lus skam nas 'chi ba/ smyo byed kyi gdon༞ grib lus tshad sems mkhar gnod/ gnon gyi gdon༞ brjed byed kyi༞ gnon po'i longs spyod lus la gnon/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon༞ nam gru'i lha mo/ gdon༞ gshin rje'i glang gi mgo can/ gdon༞ bya'i 'dab chags kyi mgo can/ gdon༞ ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i ma mo'i pho nya/ gdon༞ kun tu 'gro ba'i gdon༞ 'gro ba'i gdon/ tsher ma 'don༞ yud tsam na bar byed pa'i gdon/ rims nyin gcig pa༞ nad rims dgu la sogs/ nyin gnyis pa༞ nyin gsum pa༞ nyin bzhi pa༞ nyin bdun pa༞ rtag pa'i 'phrad na drag tu chom/ rims༞ rims shin tu drag po 'joms su rung / mi zad pa༞ rims ldang du dub pa༞ rlung las gyur pa༞ mkhris pa las gyur pa༞ bad kan las gyur pa༞ 'dus pa las gyur pa༞

rims nad thams cad dang༞ klad pa na ba dang / gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang / kha nad dang / mgul nad dang / snying nad dang / lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang / rna ba na ba dang / so na ba dang / snying na ba dang / rtsibs logs na ba dang / rgyab༞ lto ba༞ sked pa༞ chu so༞ brla༞ rje ngar༞ lag pa༞ rkang pa༞ yan lag༞ nying lag༞ rims dang shu ba dang / g.yan pa dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / mdze dang / phol mig dang / bas ldag dang / me dbal dang / g.yan pa dang / lhog pa dang / skems pa dang / skrag pa dang / dbyig dug dang / dug sbyar ma dang / byad dang / me dang / chu dang / mi ngas dang / dgra dang / gnod pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa de dag thams cad kyi rig sngags bcings par bgyi'o/ /gzi brjid 'phrog par bgyi'o/ /gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad gcad par bgyi'o/ /gdon thams cad bzlog par bgyi'o/ /gnod pa thams cad bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /gdugs dkar mo rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog ma chen mo 'dis dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad du gnod pa thams cad bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /gong bzhin/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog cig swā hā/ oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha badz+ra ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rol mo drag po bya/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ oṃ dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas kyi bye brag ji snyed yod pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa rnam pa mchod yon la sogs pa mchod rdzas so sor snang ba/ ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed nus pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can/

'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung ltar bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas dpral bar bskor nas mthar se gol bya/ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ so so'i rgya/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wed+ya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ rol mo bya zhing / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sa ra pra mar+dha ni/ ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+re/ ma hā bid+ya badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ṭo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha na badz+re swā hā/ zhes mchod sprin gyi sngags rol mo'i bar brjod de mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag chen pos thog drangs zhes ngag 'don skabs thob mdzad/ bdag gzhan khams gsum 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /nyer gcig bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis bsgom bzlas bgyis pa'i bsod nams 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur tu 'grub par shog /gsum/ slob dpon tsaṇ+ḍa go mis rang skad cig gis lha mor bskyed pa'i oṃ gyi 'od zer zhes gsungs pa'i/ rang bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i snying kha'i dbus su/ paṃ yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri ma med pa'i shel ltar dkar zhing gsal ba'i oṃ gyi yi ge de las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pa rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar can 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can/ /zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan/ /phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ /gtsug tor las byung khyed phyag 'tshal/ /gzhan gyis mi thub la sogs pa'i/ /sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ /bdag yid gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdung bdun de bzhin gshegs pa bcu/ /rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang dang / /drang srong rig 'dzin grub rnams la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan pa srung mdzad bgegs dpung 'joms/ /gzhan gyis mi thub stobs dang ldan/ /legs nyes btang 'dzin dam tshig can/ /legs ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha dog ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /mthu dang sde dang bzhon par bcas/ /thabs dang snying rjes 'jig rten kun/ skyong mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so so'i sngags rgya dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā re ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pād+yaṃ/

pād+yaṃ gi gnas su/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta'i bar so sor bcug la mchod/ zhabs bsil dkyil chog 'dir mi 'byung yang gzhan du 'byung bas kha bskang ba la nyes pa med do/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyis/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gsum/ badz+ra bsdu rgya phyir bstan/ tshogs rten gyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar bya/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring mtha' dag dang bral nas/ chags sdang med pa'i ngang nas sems btang snyoms par bya/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /stong par gyur stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems yi ge oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gdug dkar oṃ gyis 'grel pa nas gtso bo 'di rnams kyi zhal phyag rnam dag gsungs pa med do/ /mtshan pa de las kyang 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar can/

g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa g.yon pas bdag nyid kyi yul 'khor sred bzang bcas pa khebs pa'i gdugs dkar mo bsnams pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa sa skya pa'i phyag len/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa gzhir bzhag pa yin gyi 'grel pa nas/ bcu bdun pa'i skabs gzhan gyis mi thub mar bskyed par bshad/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'am yang na/ sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma rtsa zhal dkar po zhi ba'i zhal/ g.yas zhal sngon po drag po'i zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba/ phyag g.yas dang pos gdugs dkar po rin po che'i tog gis spras pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na lcags kyu/ bzhi pa na mda'/ g.yon gyi dang po na rin po che'i rgyan/ gnyis pa na rdo rje dkar po/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khros pa'i lta stangs dang bcas pas ma rung pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i stod du zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo la 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su oṃ badz+ra sa mā bsdu rgya nang bstan/ dzāḥ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇi ṣa/ sogs gong bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ yang oṃ las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha dpag med badz+ra sa mā dzāḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ oṃ ā bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba thogs nas/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin la dbang bar byas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud/ rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu la brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇi ṣa/ sogs kyis gong bzhin mchod la/ dkyus na mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod gsungs kyang / mgor chu gnyis dang mjug tu rol mo sbyar ba bla ma'i man ngag yin/ bde gshegs thugs rjes gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing / /bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed phyir bzlog cing / /bde chen 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bde gshegs gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha sku me long gi gzugs brnyan nam/ lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa dbang po'i gzhu lta bur gyur/ lha mo'i thugs ka'i oṃ gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ de dag las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don byas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las ma lus pa bsgrub/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus pa ma lus pa bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ bi shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ bhe ra bhe ra/ badz+ra dha ri ni/ ban+dha ban+dha/ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ druṃ bhan+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ brgya rtsa bzlas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇi ṣa/ sogs kyis gong bzhin mchod/ bde gshegs thugs rjes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod de bdag bskyed do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su langs te kha shar du phyogs pas/ bdag nyid lha mor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dhā rā dza sa pa bsdu rgya/

ri wā ra sa mā dza dril stabs gsum bskor spos bcas 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra gdul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren gdul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes ngang las byung / /thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / /gdug pa gdul phyir 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can/ /bcom ldan khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍa ā pa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing / /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing / /bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'khyug 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog

/khro rgyal bgegs tshogs gdul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bri/ /khyod rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /gal te nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /ye shes spyan gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing / /bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba 'don mi za/ /a na le/ brjod cing rol mo drag po bya/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug ste bgegs bskrad/ de nas phur bu bcu snod mdzes par bkod/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las shar gyi phur bu khro bo rnam rgyal sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /shar lho'i phur bu khro bo dbyug sngon can sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dbyug pa g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /lho'i phur bu khro bo gshin rje gshed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas be con g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /lho nub kyi phur bu khro bo mi g.yo ba sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /nub kyi phur bu khro bo rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas be con/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /nub byang gi phur bu khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas lcags kyu g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /byang gi phur bu khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /byang shar gyi phur bu khro bo khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/

g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /steng gi phur bu khro bo hūm̐ ka ra sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /'og gi phur bu khro bo stobs po che sku mdog dud kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas tho ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /khro bo de thams cad kyang nyi ma lta bu'i spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa zhal mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang / dbu skra dang / sma ra thams cad dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa smad phur bu'i rnam par gyur/ hūm̐ nga'i zhes g.yas sngon 'gro'i gzhi bca' pus mo g.yon btsugs te/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod a dz+nyā pa ya ti kā ya wak+tsit+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra a ko ṭa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces shar gyi phur bu gdab/ oṃ ni sum+bha badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces phur bu'i 'gros kyis shar lhor song ste/ hūm̐ nga'i zhes rkang pa g.yas sngon 'gro'i gzhi bca' pus mo g.yon btsugs te shar lho'i phur bu gdab/ de nas de bzhin du/ lho/ lho nub/ nub/ nub byang / byang / byang shar/ steng gi shar gyi shar dang / 'og gi nub kyi nub rnams su phur bu gdab/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug nas/ rkang mthil gyi bar phug ste/ lus g.yo 'gul med cing sems mi rtog par gyur/ 'di yan la zhag gi bar chod na/ bdag bskyed la sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ yig brgya gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nas/ de kun 'phags mas bzod par mdzod/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra bsdu rgya phyir bstan/

muḥ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ rang dam tshig par gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ slob dpon tsaṇ+ḍa go mi'i bzod par gsol zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos nas gshegs su gsol/ de nas lus bsrung byas te ldang bar bya'o/ /langs nas mdo sde zab mo bklag pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /rtag tu 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo dran par bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /che ba'i che mchog gi bkra shis bya ste/ nub dang po'i cho ga'o/ /sang gso sbyong nas/ bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed bsgom/ zhag gis bar ma chod na/ phur gdab kyi rjes thog nyid la sa'i dbus su dri'i thig le me tog tshom bu bkod mdun du/ de'i g.yon nas mgo byas mchod gtor bshams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su praṃ las sa'i lha mo ser mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag na bum pa thogs pa rang gi 'od kyis bskor ba sa gzhi na pad+ma dkar po chig rkyang gi nang nas lus phyed byung nas me tog tshom bu'i steng du bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan te sa la lan gsum brdab/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ de'i sgra dang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo ye shes pa byung ste/ dzaḥ bsdu rgya hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang 'dres par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ gtso mos dbu brgyan par gyur/ sngar bzhin mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ khyad par/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ bla ma dang sa'i lha mo'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wi pa sa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pad+yaṃ? sogs bcug pas mchod/ khyed ni sa yi lha mo ste/ /sku phyed 'thon cing gser gyi mdog

/rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sa 'og gtso mo khyed la 'dud/ /gtor ma mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wi sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba ta khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gh+ṝh+ṇa dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ gsum pa rdor dril spos bcas 'dzin pas/ gdangs rab 'bring tha gsum byas la/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyed ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyobs pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi stobs/ /pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ gsum/ rig sngags 'chang / dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gsung ste sa de nyid du thim par gyur/ tshom bu dang mchod gtor bsdu/ de nas las thig rdzogs par btab/ slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas/ /dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang / lha gnas gzhan rnams su zlum po re byas/ so so'i sngags brjod cing / dri'i thig le steng du las kyi rdo rjes me tog tshom bu re bkod/ 'dod snam steng nas mchod pa gru bzhir bshams/ mthar ras skor gyis bskor/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ khor yug tu rdo rje'i ra ba dra ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ phyogs mtshams thams cad ye shes kyi me bskal pa 'jigs pa'i me dpung lta bur 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su suṃ yongs su gyur pa las lhun po shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga

byang gser las grub pa'i bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje rin po che'i lcogs brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang pa/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta bab bzhi dang ldan pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo/ ser/ dmar/ ljang / dkar po'i rtsigs pa rim pa lnga'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po/ de'i steng na chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab la 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i sham bu dkar po/ mda' yab dkar po pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can/ de dag gi bar du bum pa la gnas pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ ba dan kha dog sna tshogs pas mtshan pa/ phyi nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu las mchod pa'i lha mo dpag med rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod par byed pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus dkar ba'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i phyi rol du hūm̐ las 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ dbus kyi lte bar seng ge'i khri dang pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du yi ge oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa de las kyang 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can rnams 'phags ma gdugs dkar can gyi go 'phang la bkod khyad par 'jigs par byed pa'i gdon dang mdangs 'phrog pa'i gdon thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/

rtsa zhal nyis brgya zhi ba dang snying rje'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas zhal nyis brgya sgeg pa dang dpa' ba'i zhal ser mo/ rgyab zhal nyis brgya rgod pa dang drag shul gyi zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal nyis brgya rngam pa dang nyams sna tshogs pa'i zhal ljang khu/ steng zhal nyis brgya mi sdug pa dang 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal sngon po/ zhal re re la nyams sna tshogs pa'i spyan gsum gsum mtshan pa/ zhal la la bzhad pa/ zhal la la mche ba gtsigs pa/ zhal la la gdengs pa/ zhal la la ljags 'dril zhing ha ha zhes drag tu bzhad pa phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ phyag g.yas dang po 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin/ g.yas 'og ma rnams la 'khor lo dgu bcu go dgu/ rdo rje brgya/ rin po che brgya/ pad+ma brgya/ sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba brgya bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po mda' dang bcas pa'i gdugs dkar po rin po che'i tog gis spras pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon 'og ma rnams na mda' dgu bcu go dgu/ gzhu brgya/ lcags kyu brgya/ zhags pa brgya/ ral gri 'bar ba brgya 'dzin pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas lnga brgya bskum zhing g.yon lnga brgya brkyang bas 'jigs par byed pa'i gdon thams cad dang / mdangs 'phrog pa'i gdon thams cad dang / ma rung pa'i gnod byed thams cad mnan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos bzang pos stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba/ sku'i cha thams cad la zur gyis blta ba dang / rnam par bgrad pa dang / glog ltar 'khyug pa la sogs pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong phrag mang pos ma rung pa thams cad 'jigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ spyi bo'i gtsug na me lce 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags su khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa rā gdengs pa'i 'od rab tu 'bar bas mtshan pa/ 'phags pa thams cad la mchod pa dang / sdug bsngal can rnams la skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang / ma rungs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa ste 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dbus na gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/

/de'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las gzhan gyis mi thub ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ dzam+bha na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ shar gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la glang po'i che'i khri dang pad zla'i steng du gtum chen ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ gzhan gyi sbyor ba ngan pa 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /'di man chad thams cad la g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad par sbyar ro/ /oṃ satwam+bha na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ lho phyogs kyi pad+ma'i 'dab mar rta'i khri dang pad zla'i steng du 'bar ba chen mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas rin po che g.yon 'gre/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ nub kyi pad+ma'i 'dab mar rma bya'i khri dang pad zla'i steng du gos dkar can ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pad+ma/ g.yon༞ gsod pa dang bcing ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa'o/ /oṃ sam+bhak+ṣa na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ byang gi pad+ma'i 'dab mar nam mkha' lding gi khri dang pad zla'i steng du sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon༞ rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'joms pa'o/ /oṃ ban+dha na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ byang shar gyi pad 'dab dang zla ba'i steng du rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal phyag 'gre/ g.yas dbyug pa/ g.yon༞ dug thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'o/ /oṃ sa ra bi ṣa bak+ṣa na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ shar lho'i 'dab mar zla ba'i steng du pad+ma'i mngon mtshan can sku mdog ser mo zhal g.yas lcags kyu༞ g.yon༞ mtshon gyi gnod pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'o/

/oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭa ṇaṃ satwam+bha na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrī+īḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ lho nub kyi pad 'dab dang zla ba'i steng du gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal༞ g.yas rdo rje'i phreng ba༞ g.yon༞ me dang chu'i gnod pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa hā gra ha naṃ bi dhāṃ sa na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ nub byang gi pad 'dab dang zla ba'i steng du/ rdo rje mchu can ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal༞ g.yas pa ral gri༞ g.yon༞ gnod sbyin dang srin po thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dha bi dza ya kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nyid kyi phyi rol gyi shar phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du khro bo rnam rgyal sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'gre/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon༞ shar phyogs dri za'i gdon dang / gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams dang / zas su mngal za ba dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su zhag za ba'i gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dha ni la daṇ+ḍa kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar lho'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du khro bo dbyug sngon can/ sngon po zhal༞ g.yas dbyug pa༞ g.yon༞ shar lho me lha'i gdon dang / zas su sbyin sreg za ba dang / rnag za'i gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dha ya mān+ta ka kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du khro bo gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog mthing ga zhal༞ g.yas be con g.yon༞ lho phyogs gshin rje'i gdon dang zas su rkang dang btsas pa dang / srog 'phrog pa dang gtor ma za ba'i gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dha ar+ya a tsa le kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho nub kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du khro bo mi g.yo ba sku mdog sngon po zhal༞

g.yas ral gri g.yon༞ lho nub srin po'i gdon dang / zas su phreng ba dang / dri za'i gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dha ha ya gṛ ba kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du khro bo rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal༞ g.yas be con/ g.yon༞ nub phyogs chu lha'i gdon dang / zas su bdug pa dang me tog dang / 'bras bu dang lo tog za ba'i gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dhā rā dza kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub byang gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog dmar po zhal༞ g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon༞ nub byang rlung lha'i gdon dang / zas su tshil dang sha za ba'i gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang khu zhal༞ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon༞ byang phyogs gnod sbyin dang / zas su phyi sa za ba dang / gcin 'thung ba dang / lhag ma dang / mchil ma za ba'i gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dhā trai lokya bi dza ya kī li kī li ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du khro bo khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog nag po zhal༞ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon༞ byang shar dbang ldan gyi gdon dang / zas su ngar snabs dang / snabs za ba'i gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha hūm̐ ka ra kī li kī li ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i shar gyi g.yas phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ khro bo hūm̐ ka ra sku mdog ser po zhal g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon༞ steng phyogs tshangs pa'i gdon dang mdangs 'phrog pa dang /

zas su skyug pa za ba'i gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha ma hā ba la kī li kī li ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rta mgrin gyi nub kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du/ pad+ma ma dang nyi ma'i steng du khro bo stobs po che sku mdog dud kha zhal༞ g.yas tho ba/ g.yon༞ 'og phyogs sa bdag gi gdon dang / zas su gtor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba dang / mi gtsang ba za ba'i gdon thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /khro bo de dag thams cad kyang nyi ma lta bu'i spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang / dbu skra dang / sma ra thams cad dmar ser gyen du mdzes pa rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na gdugs pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /'grel pa las nye ba'i lha mo bzhi ni zhi ba yin pas sngags snga ma dang 'dra bar dgongs so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ oṃ ban+dha na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ gzhal yas khang gi byang shar gyi lha rnams kyi grwar pad zla'i steng du zhi ba'i lha mo sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas bdug spos/ g.yon༞ sdang ba'i dgra rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ pa ra bi ṣa bak+ṣa ṇa ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ shar lho'i grwar pad zla'i steng du zhi ba gser phreng can ma sku mdog ser mo zhal༞ g.yas me tog gi phreng ba༞ g.yon༞ ma rung dgra gcan thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭa naṃ stam+bha na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ lho nub kyi grwar pad zla'i steng du dkar chen 'bar ba ma sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa g.yas me'i sdong bu g.yon༞ bdud dang gshin rje'i 'chi ltas thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa hā grwa ha naṃ bi dh+wan+sa na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ nub byang gi grwar pad zla'i steng du 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog mar gad kyi mdog can zhal༞

g.yas ral gri dung phor/ g.yon༞ 'chi ltas dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ sarba sa ra bid+ya ts+tshe da na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ shar sgor pad zla'i steng du rdo rje lu gu rgyud sku mdog sngon mo zhal༞ g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon༞ pha rol gyi rig sngags ngan pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ tsa tu ra shi tī naṃ gra hā sa ha sra ni bi dh+wan+sa ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ lho sgor pad zla'i steng du rdo rje gzhon nu ma sku mdog gser bzang ltar ser ba zhal༞ g.yas zhags pa/ g.yon༞ gdon rnams thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ aṣ+ṭa biṃ sha ti nāṃ na k+ṣa pra sa dā na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ nub sgor pad zla'i steng du lag na rdo rje ma sku mdog byi ru'i mdog ltar dmar ba zhal༞ g.yas lcags sgrog g.yon༞ sgyu skar dga' bar mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ aṣ+ṭa ṇaṃ mahā gra ha naṃ bi dh+wan+sa ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ byang sgor pad zla'i steng du rdo rje rin chen ma sku mdog ljang khu zhal༞ g.yas dril bu/ g.yon༞ gza' brgyad 'jigs par mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar lha mo thams cad kyang rin po che rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos bzang pos stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba/ zhabs pad zla'i steng nas sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal bcom ldan 'das ma la mngon du phyogs pa/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /lha so so'i sngags shu rang ga badz+ra'i 'grel ba bzhin bris pa yin no/ /lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon/ de thams cad las 'od zer 'phros 'og min gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs la 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā bsdu rgya dang zhwa phud rdor dril bcas 'dzin pas/

dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par bstsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ma hā kā ru ṇi ka a h+ya hi/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ oṃ mchod yon rgya/ sarba ta thā ga ta a hā ra pu dza me gha sa mu dra wa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ye swāhā/

/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag kyang sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūm̐ khrus kyi rgya/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma tsan+d+ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭan+tu swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre nyer spyod so so'i rgya/ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra ad+gu sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sh+ya hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra a be sha āḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa rnams gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa bsdu rgya/ mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa nas sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang / chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ shar phyogs pa la mi bskyod pa/ lho phyogs pa la rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub phyogs pa la 'od dpag med/ byang phyogs pa la don grub kyis dbu brgyan kha cig gtso 'khor thams cad la mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par 'dod/ kha cig gtso 'khor rnams la rigs lnga so sos dbu brgyan par 'dod pas/ yid ches khungs btsun las rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs par mdzad/ yum lngas dbang bskur ba dang / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po zhes pa'i tshigs bcad rnams rnal 'byor bla med kyi lugs yin pas 'dir 'bri rgyu mi rung ngo /

zhes chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches gsal por gsung bzhin du/ gdugs dkar dang phyag rdor sogs la rigs lngas dbang bskur bar dgongs pa mdzad/ yum rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa thogs te zhes sogs brjod pa ni rgyud sde'i don dang 'gal zhing chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i rjes 'jug tu khas len bzhin du de'i gsung dang dngos su 'gal ba'i nor tshabs shin tu che ba yin no/ /lha sta gon dang bum pa sta gon/ mchod bstod sogs so sor byed pa'am/ cho ga zor yangs pa'i ched du phyogs gcig tu byed na bum pa gnyis bshams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lto ba yangs pa/ mchu 'phyang ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ kha khyer dang ldan pa/ rtsa ba dang nag nog med pa/ mgrin pa ras dkar po zung gis dkris pa/ de'i nang du/ oṃ tap+te tap+te mahā tap+te swā hā/ lha'i dal 'gro'i chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga rnams kyis yongs su gang zhing / oṃ kalpa bṛk+ṣa ye swāhā/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ steng du gdugs dkar po phub par gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i nas/ zhal thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma la mngon du phyogs pa gdugs pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar du sta gon gyi skabs bzhin lha thams cad bskyed/ las bum gdugs dkar la las thams cad pa'i lha gsum gdam kar bshad 'dug pas dang po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ni zla'i steng du hūm̐ dang sna tshogs rdo rje las bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon zhi ma khro g.yas sna tshogs rdo brje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur bsten pa rin po che'i rgyan dang lha rdzas kyi na bza' can pad zla la sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag don grub/ sngags/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so/ /gnyis pa phyag rdor ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi na ya ga gdan du bting ba/ sku mdog sngon po sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /me'i phung po'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa sngags/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ban+dha ban+dha badz+ra pā sha ma ma sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ bi gha na bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa dkyil chog 'dir bstan pa bzhin gzhan gyis mi thub ma'o/ /de la las bum gyi nang du paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzhan gyis mi thub ma nas dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir bsdu na lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ nas sa mā dzaḥnyer spyod kyis mchod dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho zhes pas dam tshig pa dang nas༞ zhes pa'i bar gong gi sta gon bzhin byed/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ nas byang phyogs pa la don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ las bum gyi gzhan gyis mi thub ma la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid du thim par gyur/ de nas mchod pa rnams gzhan gyis mi thub mas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa thams cad rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par byed pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam pa thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / khyad par bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya oṃ sarba bid nas s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ar+gha ཾnas/ shap+ta'i bar mchod sngags so sos byin gyis brlab/ de nas tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas mchod pa ni/ oṃ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan nas 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / bdag kyang blo dang ldan par mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā re thams cad kyi mgor sbyar/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye āḥhūm̐/ bde bar gshegs so nas mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil bcug ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pād+yaṃ bcug dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed cing / /kha dog dbyibs legs mdzes pa'i me tog 'di/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas/ /gzhal med khang du sprin bzhin 'thibs gyur cig puṣ+pe/ tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te/ /sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pa'i/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig dhū pe༞ nyon mongs dug sogs ma rig mun sel ba'i/ /shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du/ /'od zer snang bas phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig ā lo ke༞ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i/ /spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i chu/ /ye shes mkha' las bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pas/ /mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /gan+dhe༞ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos/ /dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags na/ /ye shes thugs rje can gyis bzhes su gsol/ nai wid+ye/ dril chen gsung snyan rnam rol tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /bsam gtan ngag gis bstod de gus mchod na/ /sa bcu rim gyis bgrod de thogs med nas/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por smon/

shap+ta pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ mdzes sdug yid 'ong gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra/ /bsil byed tsan dan dri dang ro brgya'i zas/ /mnyen 'khril pañtsa li ka reg na bde/ /'dod yon sna lnga rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /'bul gyis bzhes nas dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ka ma gu na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag gis/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ /bsam zhing yid kyis sprul te 'bul lags na/ /'gro ba mi zad gter la longs spyod shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sap+ta rat+na badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang gdugs dkar lha tshogs la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta aṣ+ṭa mad+ga la gra bye badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rgyas par spro na gzhan yang phyi'i mchod pa ci shes pas mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ bde dril stabs gsum skor byed cing / gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing / /bde 'byung bstan la gnod pa phyir bzlog cing / /bde chen 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ sh+lau ka rer dril bsil mdzad/ bde gshegs gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs sbyin la sogs phyag rgya sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri mda' gzhu zhags sogs bsnams pa yi/ /phyag stong mnga' ba khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu dang zhabs phyag sku yi cha rnams las/ /zur gyis blta dang rnam par bgrad pa dang / /glog ltar 'khyug sogs bye ba brgya stong gi /spyan rnams mnga' ba khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje lta bur mi phyed brtan pa'i sku/ /dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i me dpung gis/ /gegs rnams 'joms shing dngos grub kun stsol ba'i/ /mi phyed 'bar ba khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'bar ba'i mthus/

/thogs pa med cing shin tu yangs pa yis/ /sa gsum dkyil 'khor kun la mnga' mdzad ma/ /srid gsum dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi thugs kar gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis char sprin ltar gnag cing / /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /'byung po tshar gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar gyi pad+ma'i 'dab mar gtum chen ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gangs ri'i mdog ltar dkar/ /phyag g.yas 'khor lo g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /gzhan gyi sbyor ngan 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho yi pad+ma'i 'dab mar 'bar chen ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser gyi mdog ltar ser/ /phyag g.yas rin chen g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /g.yon 'gre/ dus min 'chi ba 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub kyi pad+ma'i 'dab mar gos dkar mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar dmar can/ /phyag g.yas pad+ma g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ gsod dang bcing ba 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang gi pad+ma'i 'dab mar sgrol ma ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis margad ltar ljang ba/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /rmi lam ngan pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar 'dab mar rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis nam mkha'i mdog ltar sngo/ /phyag g.yas dbyug pa g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /dug rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar lho'i 'dab mar pad+ma'i mngon mtshan can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs shing / /phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /mtshon gyi gnod pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub 'dab mar gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis li khri'i mdog ltar dmar/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje phreng ba g.yon༞ me chu'i gnod pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang 'dab mar rdo rje mchu can ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mar gad ltar 'jam zhing / /phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/

/gnod sbyin srin po 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar gyi 'khor lor khro chen rnam par rgyal/ sku mdog dkar mo shin tu bzhad pa'i zhal/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /shar phyogs gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar lho'i rtsibs la khro chen dbyug sngon can/ /sku mdog sngon mo shin tu 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /phyag g.yas dbyug tho g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /shar lho'i gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho yi 'khor lo khro rgyal gshin rje gshed/ sku mdog mthing nag shin tu gdengs pa'i zhal/ /phyag g.yas be con g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /lho yi gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub rtsibs la khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon/ /sku mdog sngon po shin tu khros pa'i zhal/ /phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /lho nub gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub kyi 'khor lor khro rgyal rta mgrin rgyal/ /sku mdog dmar mo shin tu gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /phyag g.yas be con g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /nub phyogs gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang rtsibs la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /sku mdog dmar nag shin tu rngams pa'i zhal/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /nub byang gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs 'khor lo khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /sku mdog ljang nag shin tu 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon༞ byang phyogs gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar rtsibs la khro bo khams gsum rgyal/ /sku mdog nag po shin tu khros pa'i zhal/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /byang shar gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i shar du hūm̐ ka ra/ /sku mdog ser po shin tu rngams pa'i zhal/ /phyag g.yas 'khor lo g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /steng phyogs gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/

/rta mgrin rgyal po'i nub tu stobs po che/ /sku mdog dud kha shin tu gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /phyag g.yas tho ba g.yon pas༞ 'og phyogs gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar mtshams su zhi ba'i lha mo ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ston ka'i zla ltar dkar/ /phyag g.yas bdug spos g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /dgra rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar lho'i mtshams su zhi ba gser phreng can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis btso ma gser gyi mdog /phyag g.yas gser phreng g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /ma rungs sgra gcan 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub mtshams su skar chen 'bar ba mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar dmar can/ /phyag g.yas mar me g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /sdang ba'i gshin rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang mtshams su 'phags ma sgrol ma ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog margad mdog /phyag g.yas dung chos g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /'chi ltas rmi ngan 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar gyi sgo ru rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis nam mkha'i mdog 'dra zhing / /phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /pha rol rig sngags 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho yi sgo ru rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs shing / /phyag g.yas zhags pa g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub kyi sgo ru lag na rdo rje ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis byi ru'i mdog ltar dmar/ /phyag g.yas lcags sgrog g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /rgyu skar dga' bar byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang gi sgo ru rdo rje rin chen ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis margad ltar 'jam zhing / /phyag g.yas dril bu g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /gza' rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ las bum la/ pad ma'i lte bar gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ nas/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis char sprin ltar gnag cing /

/phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /gdon bgegs tshar gcod khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me tog dang bcas pa'i lte bar pad kor gyis gzungs thag blangs nas g.yas kyis bzung / g.yon phreng ba 'dren pas/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la brten nas song bas lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ gtso mo'i a na le/ lha sta gon du bshad pa'i lha sngags so so nyer gcig re/ las bum la/ oṃ de wi badz+ra dha ri ban+dha ban+dha ni badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭaḥ oṃ hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃḥ nyer gcig 'di gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sngags su 'grel par bshad/ de nas dung chos kyi chu la/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ lan bdun bzla/ gzungs thag bsdu/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā re ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ dung chos kyi mchod yon bum pa gnyis su blugs de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su/ me tog bdug spos/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ puṣ+pe/ dhūpe brjod nas/ me tog dang spos phul/ bcom ldan 'das bum pa'i lha tshogs kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa byad byur skal ba ngan pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ gzhan gyis mi thub mas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar la bgegs thams cad bzlog par mdzod/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa zhu ba las bdud rtsi'i chur gyur/ gzhal yas khang zhu nas bum par gyur/ las bum bsgrubs zin 'di nas bzung gshegs gsol ma grub bar gyi bdag mdun gyi gsang ba gang du byung ba thams cad/

las bum gyi chu dang gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i sngags kyis byed dgos/ de nas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor la snyan gsan ni/ rdor dril spos bcas 'dzin pas/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ gdangs rab 'bring tha gsum dang bcas oṃ badz+ra dzi hwaṃ/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar lha mo mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon po bri bar 'tshal lags na/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan 'das mar bdag ni gus/ /des ni bka' drin mdzad par rigs/ /'gro ba'i 'khor lo bya don stsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'bras gnas dang / /'jig rten skyong ba ma lus dang / /'byung po byang chub nyer gnas dang / /gang dag rdo rje spyan mnga' ba'i/ /bstan la mngon par dga' ba kun/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge ste/ /'phags ma gdugs dkar dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar gus pa'i yo byad kyis/ /'gro ba'i don phyir 'bri lags na/ /thugs rje brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /dkyil 'khor lhan cig gyur pa kun/ /nye ba ru ni mdzad par rigs/ /lan gsum bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa sang nangs par rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du spyan 'dren na 'byon pa ci gnang ba chen po mdzad du gsol/ dkyil chog du skabs 'dir slar yang mchod de gshegs su gsol zhes dang thig gi gong na/ dkyil 'khor bteg la thig las bya/ zhes sta gon gshegs pa dang nam mkhar 'degs pa gnyis gdam kar gsungs pa las 'dir gshegs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa sogs sbyar ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod badz+ra muḥ sta gon gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ zhes brjod de sta gon gyi mchod pa dang /

tshom bu sogs dkyus 'di yan la zhag chod byed na sngar bzhin bdag bskyed la mchod bstod nas bkra shis kyi bar bya ste/ sta gon no/ /sang gso sbyong nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed bsgom/ zhag gis bar ma chod na/ sta gon gshegs gsol grub 'phral thig tshon phyogs gcig byas na 'jug bde bas/ rang gi mdun du tshon dkar po las oṃ bris pa dbus su mgo bo nub tu bstan nas bzhag sngon po la hūm̐ bris pa shar du/ ser po la trāṃ bris pa lhor/ dmar po la hrīḥbris pa nub tu/ ljang gu la āḥbris pa byang du/ de dag dang mthun pa'i ye thig so so yang tshon so so'i steng du phyogs ma 'chol bar bkod/ las bum gyi chu dang gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur stong pa'i ngang las thig tshon dkar po oṃ las bcom ldan 'das rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ sngon po hūm̐ las bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gi༞ ser po trāṃ las bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi༞ dmar po hrīḥlas bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi༞ ljang gu āḥlas bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi༞ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi zla/ mig 'bras hūm̐ thung las rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ dip+ta driṣ+ṭa aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags dang / rdzi ma 'dug pa'i phyag rgyas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi thig tshon bkug nas/ dam tshig gi thig tshon so so la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrīḥhūm̐/ rigs lnga so sos dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang /

/gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gshegs/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhu ba las byung ba'i ngo bo rigs lnga la rnam pa thig tshon du gyur/ slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas grogs rdor dril 'dzin pa la thig sna gtad thog mar so sor bsgril/ de nas lnga po gcig tu bsgril zhing / oṃ a a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmās ra sa ra a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥ a t+yan+ta a nu pra w-iṣ+ṭaḥ thig skud bsdogs nas rin po che'i snod du bzhag lag gnyis rdor dril bcas pas steng khu tshur gyi mdzub mo gnyis kyis tshon mnye zhing / oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ tshon re re la bdun bdun bzlas/ tshon rnams la hrī re re bris/ lag gnyis rdor dril dang bcas pas rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams la rdul mang zhing / /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can rnams la chags pas bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig hrīḥhrīḥ zhes sbar/ de nas slob dpon rdor dril thogs pa nub dang grogs shar du gnas pa dzaḥ zhes thig sna slob dpon gyi lag g.yas kyis gtad/ grogs kyi g.yon pas drangs shing / dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod/ nub dang lhor gnas tshang thig gnyis/ me rlung de nyid mer gnas pas/ shar nub byang lho'i rtsa thig gdab/ de nyid dang ni bden bral du/ gnas pa'i zur thig gnyis po gdab/ slob dpon 'dug pa'i dbang du byas/ slob ma de las bzlog pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po nam mkha' la se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas gcus thig gdab/ de nas sa la gdab cing / sems can don du dus yun gyi/ /de phyir khyed rnams 'dir byon cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya pu traṃ mā ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes brjod/ btab tshar nas/ thig skud kyi ye shes pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/

badz+ra muḥ thig gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma hūm̐/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas dbus su phyin nas/ kro dha driṣ+ṭi hīḥ gsum gsum brjod pa'i sgo'i nang gi rtsa thig dbye/ rang gi mig las rdo rje 'phros pas thar pa'i sgo'i bar chad thams cad bcom par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bai ga a kra ma hūm̐/ zhes shar nas phyir 'thon/ de nas dkyil 'khor lhag chad med par dkyil chog gi bris cha'i gzhung bzhin legs par bris te sta gon gyi nam mkha' dwangs pa bzhin/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba bzhin/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bzhin/ /dbang po'i mtshon cha bkram pa bzhin/ /'od kyi phung po 'bar ba bzhin/ /rin chen gter kha phye ba bzhin/ /me tog sna tshogs skyed tshal bzhin/ /mdzes dgu gcig tu spungs pa bzhin/ /lag pa gcig gi 'du byed bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar bris grub pa dang / tshon lhag gi ye shes pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis mchod/ badz+ra muḥ tshon lhag gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar dri bzang dang snum 'dres pas byugs/ me tog bkram/ gtso mo'i bum pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañdzi'i steng du bzhag las bum sgrub dus dbang ldan du/ rgyun du slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du 'jim pa la ched du bzos pa'am/ med na leb ma mdzub gang tsam brgyad bzhag pa la/ mda' brgyad gzug cing de la tshon skud sna lngas dra ba bya ste/ de yang dang por dbang ldan gyi mda'i rtsa ba la tshon skud kyi sne mo btags la de shar gyi mda'i rtse mor khyer nas dkris/ de bzhin du shar lho'i rtsa ba dang lho'i rtse mo dang / lho nub kyi rtsa ba dang / nub kyi rtse mo dang / nub byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang gi rtse mo dang / byang shar gyi rtse mo dang / de nas byang shar gyi rtse mo dang / shar gyi rtsa ba dang / shar lho'i rtse mo dang /

lho'i rtsa ba dang / lho nub kyi rtse mo dang / nub kyi rtsa ba dang / nub byang gi rtse mo dang / byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang shar gyi rtse mo dang / de nas shar gyi rtse dang / de nas mda' gnyis gnyis bor te lho nub kyi rtse la dkris/ de bzhin du/ byang gi rtse mo dang / shar lho'i rtse dang / nub kyi rtse dang / byang shar gyi brtse dang / lho'i rtse dang / nub byang gi rtse dang / shar gyi rtse dang / de nas re re bzhin du shar lho/ lho/ lho nub/ nub/ nub byang / byang gi rtse la dkris te/ byang nas 'khor lo bskor ba'i lhag ma byang shar gyi mda'i rtsa bar bzhag pa'i phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i rnam pa 'byung ngo / /de nas mda' de dag gi rtse la phyogs skyong so so'i mdog can gyi lda ldi'am/ 'phan kha dog sna tshogs bkod/ bcu yod na steng 'og gi gnyis shar nub kyi rtse la'o/ /me long brgyad/ rma bya'i mdongs brgyad kyang rtse la btsugs/ phyi ngos nas dkyil 'khor la yang gzhal ba'i mda' brgyad kyi rtsa bar g.yas su phur pa brgyad/ g.yon du ral gri brgyad rnams zug go /gtor ma gtso mo la gcig sgos kyi chos skyong la gcig legs ldan gsum la re re/ cha gsum tshang ba re re/ rgyal chen bzhi la gcig gdon chen nyi shu rtsa brgyad la dmar gtor gcig dkar gtor gcig me tog dang shing tog 'bras bu sna tshogs pas brgyan pa gcig gzhi bdag la gcig ste bcu gsum bshams/ mchod pa bzang zhing rgya che bas bskor de'ang bon po'i bshos bu bzhin ma yin pa pad+ma'i snying po lta bu'i zlum gtor bya zhing / so so'i gtor rdzas tsakli sogs ma nor bar bya'o/ ༈ /rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor las bum gyi chu dang / gzhan gyis mi thub mas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa nas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid du thim par gyur zhes pa'i bar gong gi sta gon bzhin byed dkyil chog las skabs 'dir bum sgrub ma gsung kyang gzungs grwa lnga'i dkyil chog las rgyun du byed na thun gsum du nyin re bzhin bzlas pa bya'o/

/zhes gsungs pa 'dir yang mtshungs shing / dkyil chog chen mo rnams su bum pa nyin re bzhin sgrub dgos par gsungs pas bum pa bshams/ gzhan gyis mi thub mas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng bu baṃ baṃ las byung ba'i nas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid du thim par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar sngar sta gon du bstan pa bzhin/ de nas mchod bstod phyogs gcig bya ste mchod pa gsar du bshams pa'am kha gso/ mchod pa rnams gzhan gyis mi thub mas mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs/ nas/ gzhal yas khang zhu nas bum par gyur gyi bar sta gon bzhin byed/ de nas mdun bskyed la dmigs te gtso mo la/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le oṃ a na le/ bi shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bhe ta bhe ta badz+ra dha ri ni/ ban+dha ban+dha badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ druṃ ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ brgya rtsa bzla/ oṃ dzam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ satwaṃ bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ mo hā na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ sam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ ban+dha na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ pa ra bi ṣa bhak+ṣa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭa naṃ satwam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭo+oṃ/ oṃ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa hā gra hā ṇaṃ bi dh+wan+sa ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dhā bi dza ya kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dhā nī la daṇ+ḍa kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dhā ya man+ta ka kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dhā ar+ya a tsa le kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dhā ha ya gri ba kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dhā ṭak+ki rā dza kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dhā a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dhā trai lokya bi dza ya kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dhā hūm̐ ka ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa kro dhā ma hā ba la kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ban+dha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ pa ra bi ṣa bhak+ṣa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭa ṇaṃ stam+bha na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa hā gra hā ṇaṃ bi dh+wan+sa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ sarba pa ra bir yats+tsha da na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ tsa tu rā shi ti naṃ gra hā sa ha pra ṇaṃ bi dh+wan+sa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa biṃ shā tī nāṃ nak+ṣa tra ṇaṃ pra sa dā na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa ṇaṃ ma hā gra hā ṇaṃ bi dh+wan+sa na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭoṃ/ de rnams nyer gcig re bzla'o/ /de nas bla ma chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po che'i phyag 'tshal gyi mi mthun phyogs bzlog dang ri khrod lo ma gyon rnams bstod/ bdag srung gtso mo'i yon tan dran/ /'jigs pa bzlog dang gdon rnams 'joms/ /rig sngags gcad dang dam can bskul/ /bar chad bzlog dang rim nad srung / /mtshams gcad bcangs pa'i phan yon dang / /srid 'phel la sogs kha tshar las/ zhes mdo dbu zhabs bsdus pa'i sdom tshig dang / mdo las/ sangs rgyas rnal 'byor du bya'o/ /zhes pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i mdo tshar bdun ji ltar 'os pa bklag par bya ste/ bzlog pa la sogs yin na klog par byed do/ /slob ma la dbang bskur ba la ma byas kyang chad pa'i nyes pa med do/ ༈ /de nas gtor ma rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las rgyas pa bzhi bcu gsum gyi dang po gtso mo la/ gnyis pa sgos kyi chos skyong la/ gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa rnams legs ldan la/ drug pa bdun pa brgyad pa dgu pa rnams rgyal chen bzhi la/ bcu pa bcu gcig pa cha gsum bzhin phyogs skyong dang 'byung po la btang /
