bcu gnyis pa dang bcu gsum pa gdon chen nyer brgyad la/ bcu bzhi pa nas bzhi bcu zhe gcig bar/ gzi brjid 'phrog pa'i gdon rnams la 'bul/ zhe gnyis pa gzhi bdag la/ zhe gsum pa cha gsum gyi cho gas bgegs la sbyin/ gtor ma 'bring po sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lugs ni gtor chog zur na bkod pas de blta bar bya'o/ /bsdus pa gtor ma bcu gsum gyi dbang du byas pa'i dang po byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa ni/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sngags dang las bum gyi chus bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rgyas par sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ ma grub na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga to bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba ta khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swā hā/ gsum gyis phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can/ nas/ bdag nyid gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bar/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas kyis yul phyogs 'dir mi nad dang phyugs nad dang / yams nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad phyir bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ༈ /gnyis pa sgos kyi chos skyong la 'bul ba ni/ zha lu pa rnams rnam sras zhi drag bing las gshin rdo rje rab brtan ma/ ri phug ma rnams la 'bul bar mdzad pas de ltar spro na zha lu slob dpon drug gis mdzad pa'i gdugs dkar dkyil chog nag 'gros ma bzhin nas/ yang na rang gang byed kyi chos skyong la phul kyang 'thus/ gsum pa man chad sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dang po/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas gtor ma sbyong ba ni lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

gsum/ gnyis pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas spel ba ni/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar la sor mo rnams rtse sprad de tshigs rnams zur can rin po che'i sgrom ltar byas la/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba ta khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ gsum pa bdud rtsi thal sbyor gyi sngags mos par bsgyur ba ni/ lag pa thal mor sbyar ba bskyed de mthe bong gnyis bsnol la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum/ bzhi pa rgyal chen shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags rgyas spyod par dbang ba ni/ lag pa g.yas pas khu tshur bcangs la mdzub mo bsgrengs te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ gsum/ lnga pa ye shes skar mda'i sngags rgyas so sor thob par bya ba ni/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la snying khar bzhag g.yon pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas gtor ma'i snod 'degs pa'i tshul du byas la/ oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa mā ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa ya ni hūm̐/ gsum/ drug pa lha mgon spyi'i sngags rgyas dbang du bya ba ni/ lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar la sor mo rnams nang du bsnol la mthe bong gnyis gshibs te brkyangs nas/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nan gra he shwa ri pra bhañtsa ti na ma sa ma ya swa ཱhā/ las bum dang gzhan gyis mi thub mas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las legs ldan nag po dka' thub bzlog pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog nag po shin tu 'jigs pa'i zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ phyag g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ dka' thub bzlog ma'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /legs ldan nag po sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag rgya byas pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog mthing nag phyag g.yas gri gug dang /

g.yon༞ 'gre'o/ /'khor tshangs pa la sogs te lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas tsan+dan gyi bing las sprul pa'i dmag tshogs mang po 'gyed pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon༞ 'khor dur khrod na gnas pa'i ma mo dang khyab 'jug gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /de gsum yang nyi ma lta bu'i spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang / sma ra dang / dbu skyes thams cad me 'bar ba lta bu gyen du 'khyil ba dar nag sngo khra'i na bza' lhab lhub brtsegs mar gsol ba/ thod skam lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / thod rlon brgya phyed kyi do shal can/ shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis me 'od 'bar ba'i khrod na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas legs ldan mched gsum 'khor bcas spyan drangs par gyur/ 'og min bde chen pho brang nas/ /mgon po kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs/ /dpal ldan drag po chen po dang / /sred med bu dang nag po che/ /legs ldan mched gsum 'khor bcas rnams/ mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ de wa ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tad khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swāhā/ gsum/ oṃ ma hā kā la sha ri bh+yoḥ ma hā kā la duṣ+ṭi bh+yoḥ ma hā kā la duṣ+ṭaṃ bh+yoḥ i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ shā sa naṃ/ u pa kā ri ṇi o ṣā pañtsi ma ka lonya pa i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ ya di pra ti dz+nyā sma ra si ta dā i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ satwa kha khā khā hi khā hi/

ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum/ nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dur khrod 'og ma'i gnas mchog gzhal yas khang / /'jigs su rung dang bskal pa'i me/ /dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod klong dkyil nas/ /dka' thub bzlog mdzad phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mgon po khrag 'thung rgyal/ /legs ldan nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis phyag byas pa'i/ /sred med bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa 'dul/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed/ /dur khrod gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /dge legs phun gsum tshogs pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdug dkar mo can gyi bkas/ legs ldan nag po mched gsum gyis/ bdag cag slob dpon yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog pa dang / mtshon cha spang bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog cig rten med na gshegs/ yod na brtan bzhugs bya'o/ /bzhi pa rgyal chen bzhi la dbul ba ni/

ri rgyal lhun po'i phyogs bzhi nas/ /chos skyong rgyal po sde bzhi yang / /btsun mo sras dang g.yog 'khor bcas/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ma hā rā dza tsa tur sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ dhṛṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa ya/ bi ru dha kā ya/ bi ru pak+ṣā ya/ bai shrā ba ṇā ya/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te nas/ sa ma ye swāhā/ gsum/ dril gsil bya rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /margad mdog mtshungs pi waṃ 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang mdzad pa/ /yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ /kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ /grul bum tshogs la dbang sgyur ba/ /'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ /kha dog dmar ser sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang mdzad pa'i/ /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i nas/ bkas/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi bdag cag nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /shar phyogs dri za'i/ lho phyogs grul bum gyi༞ nub phyogs klu'i༞ byang phyogs gnod sbyin kyi gnod pa dang / 'tshe ba thams cad srung ba dang nas/ phyogs bzhi'i bde legs su gyur cig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog cig mahā rā dza tsa tur sā pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ las bum gyi chus lam phye rol mo drag po bya'o/ /lnga pa drug pa phyogs skyong bcu dang 'byung po la 'bul ba ni/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyel po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gdon gyi bdag

/de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston cing / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ oṃ dā sha diklo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ oṃ dā sha diklo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ༞ sogs kyis mchod/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gshin rje'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gdon dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub srin po'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs chu lha 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang rlung lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs/ /nor srung gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar dbang ldan 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'og gi klu ste sa yi lha/ sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang /

/dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ oṃ in+d+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ oṃ ya mā ye swā hā/ oṃ ni ṛ te ye swāhā/ oṃ ba ru ṇa ya swāhā/ oṃ ba ya be swāhā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swāhā/ oṃ i shwa na ya swāhā/ oṃ brah+ma ṇa ya swāhā/ oṃ sur+ya ya swāhā/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ya swāhā/ oṃ pri thi bi d+ye swāhā/ oṃ nā ge bh+yeḥswā hā/ oṃ a su re bh+yaḥswāhā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te༞ nas/ ga ga ṇa khaṃ gṛh+ṇe ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hī swāhā/ gsum/ dril gsil bya shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral gdon gyi bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po ste/ /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang / /ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams la/ /sā sā so sor gtor ma phul ba rnams/ /rab tu dges pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang / /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ rang gi bud med mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang / /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs cig tu/ /me tog dri dang byug pa gtor mar bcas/ /'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang / /bdag gi las 'di'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i༞ nas/ bkas phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob nas/ bcas pa thams cad la bsrung ba dang nas/ ston brgya mthong bar shog cig oṃ dā sha diklo ka pa la sa pa ri wā ra gāts+tsha/ las bum gyi chus gtor rol mo bya/ gdon la 'og tu rgyas par 'byung bas ma byas kyang 'thus pa 'dra yang dkyil chog tu cha gsum rgyas pa bsngos zhes gsungs pas/

tshig rkang thog mtha' gnyis la dril gsil/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bud med tshogs bcas g.yog 'khor bcas rnams la/ /bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas su/ /thal mo sbyar te khyod la gsol 'debs kyi/ gsan nas phan gdags phyir ni 'dir byon cig oṃ de wa/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ ban+dha baḥ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kīn+na ra/ ma ho ra ga a nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya/ sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ oṃ de waḥnas༞ a ma nu ṣ+ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ༞ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ de wa/ nā ga nas/ a ma nu ṣ+ya sa pa ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te nas/ khā hi khā hi swāhā/ gsum/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang / /rin chen gnas na lhag par gang gnas dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu bsil ma can na gang gnas dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stongs pa dang / /khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang / /gtsug lag khang ngam grong khyer gnas dag gam/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres dang ni/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo dag dang sum mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas dag dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod gang na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dges te mgu bar gyur nas su/ /me tog phreng dang dri dang bdug pa dang / /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di rnams bzhes te btung zhing bsnams nas su/

/las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /oṃ de waḥ nas/ sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha las bum gyi chus gtor rol mo bya/ gtor ma bdun pa dang / brgyad pa gdon nyer brgyad la dbul ba ni/ mi sdug 'tshe ba'i ngang tshul can/ /gdon chen nyi shu rtsa brgyad de/ /gzi brjid 'phrog dang mdangs 'phrog pa/ /mngal dang khrag dang sha za ba/ /tshil za rkang dang btsas pa za/ /srog 'phrog pa dang gtor ma za/ /phreng ba dri dang bdug pa za/ /me tog 'bru dang lo thog za/ sbyin sreg phyi sa rnag za ba/ /gcin 'thung mchil ma lhag ma za/ /snabs za ngar snabs mi gtsang za/ /gtor khung 'bab 'thung skyug pa za/ /de ltar gnod byed 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ h+ye heḥ gdon chen rnams so so'i gzugs la thim par gyur/ /gdon chen gnod byed nyer brgyad la/ /mthun pa'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang / /yon bdag bsam pa rdzogs par gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ gzi brjid 'phrog dang mdangs za la/ gzugs brnyan khrag snas brgyan pa 'bul/ mngal za ba la mngar gsum rtsi/ khrag 'thung ba la khrag sna 'bul/ /zhag za ba la zhag dang bcud/ /sha za ba la sha sna'i tshogs/ /tshil za ba la phyi nang tshil/ /rkang za ba la rkang mar 'bul/ /btsas pa za la bu ram dang / /shing kun sbyar ba 'di dag 'bul/ /srog 'phrog pa la 'o ma dang / /zho dang ka ra bcos pa 'bul/ /skyug pa za la sbrang rtsi dang / /mi gtsang za la sgog btsong ngo / /la phug rgyu rkyen sbyar ba 'bul/ /gcin 'thung ba la rgun 'brum chang / /'bras chang bcud dang bcas pa 'bul/ /gtor khung nas 'bab 'thung ba la/ /chu sna mang po bcud sbyar 'bul/ /lhag ma za la rdzas kun gyi/ /lhag ma bsdus la dbul bar bya/ /mchil ma 'thung la sbrang dang bcud/ /bya mo'i sgo nga snabs za la/ /ngar sgong ngar snabs za la 'bul/

/rnag za ba la rul pa'i sha /gtor ma za la 'khur ba dang / /rab tu sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'bul/ /phreng ba za la ru rak+sha/ /bodhi tsit+ta la sogs 'bul/ /dri za ba la ga pur dang / /bzang sman drug dang bcas pa 'bul/ /bdug pa za la sbyar spos dang / /dri dang 'bru mar bcas pa 'bul/ /sems 'phrog pa la sha khrag chang / /sgog btsong bcas pa'i gtor ma 'bul/ /me tog za la me tog rigs/ /'bras bu za la bu ram dang / /shing thog sna tshogs bcas pa 'bul/ /me tog za la 'bru bzang dang / /'bras dang nas kyi snye ma 'bul/ /sbyin sreg za la 'bru bcud dang / /'bras kyi lag san dbul bar bya/ /rang rang mthun rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /gnod pa'i bsam sbyor zhi ba dang / /phan pa'i bsam pa ldan par gyis/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung bar mdzod/ /sngags drug phyag drug gi skabs bzhin rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya bcas la sngags/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐ gsum/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku 'byams klas la༞ gzugs mdzes dam pa la༞ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la༞ gsum/ 'byung po'i tshogs gang su dag sa la rgyu ba rnams dang / nam mkha' la rgyu ba rnams dang / chu la rgyu ba rnams dang des 'gre/ lha klu༞ lha ma yin༞ rlung lha༞ nam mkha' lding༞ dri za༞ mi'am ci༞ lto 'phye chen po༞ gnod sbyin༞ srin po༞ yi dwags༞ sha za༞ 'byung po༞ grul bum༞ srul po༞ lus srul po༞ skem byed༞ smyo byed༞ grib gnon༞ brjed byed༞ gnon po rnams bdag la nyon cig 'byung po'i tshogs gzi brjid 'phrog pa/ mdangs 'phrog pa nas/ gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod la/ bdag la nyon cig༞ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma chen mo'i rig sngags nas 'byung ba bzhin khyed rnams la spos dang me tog dang /

bdug pa dang gtor ma yang sbyin no/ /mchod gtor 'di rnams kyis mgu bar gyis la/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog pa dang / dug zhi ba dang / mtshams bcad pa dang / yongs su bsrung ba dang / yongs su bzung ba dang / chad pa thams cad bzlog par mdzod cig rgyal po dang / chom rkun dang / me'am chu'am dug gam mi mdza' ba'am/ lam du 'gro ba'am/ lam gol bar 'gro ba'am/ gnyid log pa'am/ ra ro ba'am/ bag med pa thams cad las ming 'di zhes bya ba las bsrung bar gyis shig ming 'di zhes bya ba la sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems༞ drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems༞ lha'i gdon dang / klu'i༞ lha ma yin gyi༞ rlung lha'i༞ nam mkha' lding༞ dri za'i༞ mi'am ci༞ lto 'phye chen po༞ gnod sbyin༞ srin po'i༞ yi dwags kyi༞ sha za'i༞ skem byed kyi༞ smyo byed kyi༞ grib gnon gyi༞ brjed byed kyi༞ gnon po'i༞ mkha' 'gro ma'i༞ nam gru'i༞ gshin rje'i༞ bya'i༞ ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i༞ kun tu 'gro ba'i༞ tsher ma 'don pa'i༞ rims nyin gcig pa༞ nyin gnyis pa༞ nyin gsum pa༞ nyin bzhi pa༞ nyin bdun pa༞ rtag pa'i rims༞ rims mi bzad pa༞ rims ldang dub pa༞ rlung las gyur pa༞ mkhris pa las gyur pa༞ bad kan las gyur pa༞ 'dus pa las gyur pa༞ rims nad thams cad dang / klad pa na ba bsal du gsol/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang / kha nad dang / mgul nad dang / snying nad dang / lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang / rna ba༞ so༞ rtsib logs༞ rgyab༞ lto ba༞ sked pa༞ chu so༞ brla༞ rje ngar༞ lag pa༞ rkang pa༞ yan lag༞ nying lag༞ rims dang / shu ba༞ g.yan pa dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / mdze dang / phol mig dang / bas ldag dang / me dbal dang / g.yan pa dang / lhog pa dang / skems pa dang / skrag pa dang / dbyig dug dang / dug sbyar ma dang / byad dang / me dang / chu dang / mi ngas dang / dgra༞ gnod pa༞

dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / gzhan gyis srog 'phrog pa de dag thams cad bzlog par gyur cig gzi brjid 'phrog pa thams cad༞ 'gre/ gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad dang / gdon thams cad dang / gnod pa thams cad bzlog par gyur cig gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i rig sngags chen mo'i mthus/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la gdon thams cad las thar bar gyur cig swā hā/ las bum gyi chu gtor/ rol mo bya/ tsakli'i gzugs brnyan la bstims pas gshegs gsol mi dgos/ yul grong gnas gzhi'i bdag po sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ oṃ yul bdag grong bdag gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa/ sarba sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta nas/ khā hi khā hi swā hā/ gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid dbul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ spyir 'dzam bu gling bye ba phrag brgyad na gnas pa'i lha klu sa bdag la sogs pa gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang / 'brog gnas mched lnga dang / 'phrog ma ma bu dang bcas pa dang / bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa rnams dang / khyad par du yang yul phyogs 'di nyid dang sa phyogs 'di nyid dang / gtsug lag khang chen po 'di nyid kyi sa ri sa skor na gnas pa'i lha klu sa bdag la sogs pa gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam pa dang sbyor ba legs nyes ci byung yang / ru nga ba dang / phrag dog pa dang / sdod na bskul ma dang / 'gro na bshol 'debs pa la sogs pa gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa ma mdzad par gzhi bzang po chos ldan du skyong ba'i gnas po dang grogs po bzang po mdzad du gsol/ 'di grwa bgres tsho'i ngag rgyun sor bzhag yin/

bdag ni rnam mkhyen du bgrod pa'i bde lam bzhin 'dod don/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi bkas/ yul grong gnas gzhi'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ yul phyogs 'dir mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / yams nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrugs pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad phyir bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig na mo bdag gis bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyod/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa de/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa de/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo/ /ngag rnams bsrung zhing yid kyang rab bsdams te/ /lus kyis mi dge 'di dag mi spyad cing / /las lam gsum po 'di dag rab sbyangs te/ /drang por gsungs pa'i lam ni thob par 'gyur/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes par gyis/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyobs pa'i sras su skye/ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ a pa ras+d+ya ni gats+tsha/ khrus la sogs pa byed pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor lta bar gzhan bzhag la/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i cho ga ni/

nam yang stong par mi bzhag go /zhes gsungs pas sgrub grogs dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug gtor ma gcig mchod pa dang bcas pa khyer la sgrub khang gi phyi rol du phyin la/ bgegs gtor sngags drug phyag rgya drug bsdu na gzhan gyis mi thub mas bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum/ a kā ro༞ gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ na mo drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun kyi༞ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can phyag rgya dam can gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi༞ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob nas/ bcas pa thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs kyi rigs sa 'og sa steng sa bla gang na gnas kyang rung ste skad cig yud tsam la gnas 'dir mchis par gyur cig ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥganyis/ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pad+ma ka la ye satwaṃ/ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ oṃ ar+ghaṃḥsogs kyis mchod/ oṃ gung ka ri༞ nas/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ naḥmaḥsarba ta thā ga ta nas/ khā hi khā hi swā hā/ gsum/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang / /srin po sha rjen za ba dang / /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa/ /de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chen 'bras bu mang po yi/ /mchod pa 'di yis mgu byos la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis/ /rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing / /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa yin/

/dge slong dge sbyong de bzhin bram ze de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzems/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig 'di nas snga phyir bstan/ oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis/ /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa/ /nad de nye bar phyungs nas su/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis/ /dam tshig la ni gnas nas su/ /bdag gi bsam pa bskang bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing / /'dir ni sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad de rab tu sol mdzod la/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha/ mchod g.yogs gis mchod pa rnams mas rim gyis gtor ma'i mgo la blugs slob dpon gyis mchod yon gyi phyed gtor ma la blug phyed kyis gtor lam phye/ a na le dang gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang shes na thams cad 'joms pa sogs drag sngags bzla/ gtor ma dor rol mo bya/ de nas nye reg bya ste/ de'i sdom ni/ kha sna mig rna ba/ kha/ lag mgo lto ba rnams su gnyis gsum reg zhes sogs nang du zhugs/ sgrub khang gi sgor gnas srung gi las bum gyis bsangs/ spos kyis bdug oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje thugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ rol mo dang bcas rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya bzla zhing / dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum bya/ shar sgo nas me tog dbul te dpal chog las/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das ma 'dud/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hi hi hi hī/ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sa ra ma su kha sha ya/ su la li ta bi lā s+ya na mi ta/ na ma te na ma mi/ bha ga wan+taṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hi hi hi hī/ pra tīts+tsha ku su ma añtsa li na da hoḥ oṃ pra tīts+tsha/ badz+ra hoḥ pra ti gṛh+na satwaṃ i maṃ satwa/

ma hā ba lā/ zhes pas me tog blangs te mgo la bcings/ oṃ badz+rod ga ḍa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ bzhi pa nub nas shar sgor/ byang nas lho sgor/ shar nas nub sgor/ lho nas byang sgor dbye zhing / dmigs pas rang dbus kyi gtso mo'i nga rgyal gyis sgo srung rnams la bka' bsgos te sgo rnams phye bar bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā da bhan+dha naṃ ka ro mis phyag byas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin rgya chen po bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab ste dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i lhan thabs so/ ༈ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rnams bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mos mdzad par bsam nas/ las kyi rdo rjes khrus ras lag pa g.yon la gzar/ lag g.yon du me long la dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan 'bar ba khrus snod dang bcas pa dang / lag g.yas su las bum thogs te/ ༈ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o/ /zhes snyan mnan/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ ji ltar bltams pa༞ nas/ shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang / /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig oṃ sarba nas༞ shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i gsung la 'gag pa mi mnga' yang / /sems can ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la༞

sems can ngag gi༞ nas/ shrī hūm̐/ /rgyal ba'i thugs la 'khrul pa mi mnga' yang / /sems can yid kyi༞ rgyal ba'i thugs la༞ sems can yid kyi༞ oṃ nas/ shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /sems can lus ngag yid gsum༞ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus༞ sems can lus ngag yid༞ oṃ nas/ shrī hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang bas glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ nas/ shrī hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang dang dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ /stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i/ /spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de ltar byugs par bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ srab 'jam yangs pa lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku nyid la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra wa sa se āḥhūm̐/ khrus chu bum par blug bum pa lag tu thogs/ bum pa'i nang du lha thams cad gsal ba'i lha thams cad kyi sku las ye shes kyi chu rgyun babs pas bar chad bkrus par gyur/ gong du bum pa gshegs gsol grub kyang 'di dang 'og chu dbang gi dus skad cig gis bum nang du lha gsal 'debs dgos so/ /a na le'i mjug tu/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du so so'i mjug tu shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ btags la nad thams cad༞ rims thams cad༞ gdon thams༞ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad༞ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad༞ 'khon thams cad༞ grib thams cad༞ byad thams cad༞ byur༞ skal ba ngan pa༞ ltas ngan pa༞ mtshan ma ngan pa༞

rmi lam ngan pa༞ bkra mi shis pa thams cad༞ mtshan mo nag mo'i gdon༞ dus kyi zhags pa༞ gshin rje'i pho nya༞ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams༞ lha'i gdon thams༞ klu'i gdon༞ lha ma yin gyi gdon༞ rlung lha'i gdon༞ nam mkha' lding gi gdon༞ dri za'i gdon༞ mi'am ci'i gdon༞ lto 'phye chen po'i gdon thams༞ gnod sbyin gyi gdon༞ srin po'i gdon༞ yi dwags kyi gdon༞ sha za'i gdon༞ 'byung po'i gdon༞ grul bum gyi gdon༞ srul po'i gdon༞ lus srul po'i gdon༞ skem byed kyi gdon༞ smyo byed kyi༞ grib gnon༞ brjed byed༞ gnon po'i gdon༞ mkha' 'gro ma'i༞ nam gru'i༞ gshin rje'i༞ bya'i gdon༞ ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i༞ kun tu 'gro ba'i༞ tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon thams༞ rims nyin gcig pa thams༞ nyin gnyis pa thams༞ nyin gsum pa thams༞ nyin bzhi pa༞ nyin bdun pa thams༞ rtag pa'i rims thams༞ rims mi zad pa thams༞ rims ldang dub pa༞ rlung las gyur pa༞ mkhris pa las gyur pa༞ bad kan las gyur pa༞ 'dus pa las gyur༞ rims nad thams༞ klad pa na ba thams༞ gzhogs phyed na ba༞ yi ga 'chus pa༞ mig nad thams༞ sna nad༞ kha nad༞ mgul nad༞ snying nad༞ lkog ma'i lha gor na ba༞ rna ba na ba༞ so na ba༞ rtsibs logs na ba༞ rgyab na ba༞ lto ba na ba༞ sked pa na ba༞ chu so na ba༞ brla na ba༞ rje ngar na ba༞ lag pa na ba༞ rkang pa na ba thams༞ yan lag na ba༞ nying lag na ba༞ rims thams༞ shu ba thams༞ g.yan pa༞ 'brum bu phra mo༞ mtshan mar rdol ba༞ mdze༞ phol mig༞ bas ldag༞ me dbal༞ g.yan pa༞ lhog pa༞ skems pa༞ skrag pa༞ dbyig dug༞ dug sbyar ma༞ byad༞ me༞ chu thams cad༞ mi ngas༞ dgra༞ gnod pa༞ dus ma yin par 'chi ba༞ gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa༞ kun tu rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ phyug bdag chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞

nag po chen po dang ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ rgyal bar byed pa dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang / don kun 'grub pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ srin mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ sbring gi ri ti dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ dge sbyong mgo reg gis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ 'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad༞ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ruswā hā/ a na le'i mjug tu bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa na ye swā hā/ nas/ lag na rdo rjes byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad a pa na ye swā hā/ zhes shān+tiṃ ku ru dang a pa na ye brjes nas brjod/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / nas/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod byed thams cad dpag tshad dang rgyang grags su dengs shig rol mo drag po bya/ a na le brjod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las so/ /dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal/ /dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal/ /lha min zla ba rnams las rgyal/ /nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal bar gyur/ /rlung ni sprin las rnam par rgyal/ /rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas/ /sa yang bden par gnas pa lags/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden/ bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags/

/bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig 'di dag gis/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ yang a na le'i mthar bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣa༞ nas/ lag na rdo rjes byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes brjod/ spyi bo/ mdun/ brgyab/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon ste gnas lngar rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag bkru byab bsrung gsum mo/ /mdun du cog rtse'i steng du/ rang gi mdun du rnam rgyal g.yas su las bum/ bum pa'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal/ de'i g.yon du me tog g.yas su rdo rje dril bu rnams bshams/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rin po che dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gtso mo tha mi dad pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing chu dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /i dam gu ru maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ rig sngags lha mo chen mo dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /'phags mas bdag ni bzhugs su gsol/ ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra na ma ye swā hā/ zhes gdong g.yogs bcing / ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ gis me tog bzung la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog zhes lan gsum/ thun mong ba'i sdom pa zhes pa ni/ phar phyin theg pa la grags pa'i byang sems kyi sdom pa yin la/ de ni sngags mtshan nyid rgyud sde bzhi ka

bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka ste thams cad kyi thun mong ba yin pas/ de len pa'i cho ga yang gur las gsungs pa'i dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad dam/ gsum kas 'dzin pa gang rung gis chog par tshad ldan gyis bshad cing / thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /zhes sogs kyis 'dzin pa yin la/ 'di ni rgyud sde gong ma gnyis po kho na'i thun mong ma yin pa yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/ bya spyod gnyis la sdom pa gnyis ldan yod kyi gsum ldan med la gong ma gnyis la gsum ldan yod pas sngags kyi sdom pa'i rten du byang sems kyi sdom pa thob la ma nyams par nges par dgos shing / byang sems kyi sdom pa'i rten du yang dge bsnyen nas dge slong gi bar gang rung ba'i so thar gyi sdom pa dngos sam/ ma mtha' la'ang mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i sdom pa tsam zhig ni nges par dgos pas khyab bo/ /bya spyod tsam gyi dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gang zag gis ni byang sems kyi sdom pa'i rtsa ltung gi steng du dbang bskur ba spang ba dang / bla ma la 'khu ba spong ba bsnan pa las gzhan pa'i sngags kyi rtsa ltung bsrung mi dgos sam/ 'on kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag gi dam tshig ni bsrung rgyu mang po yod de/ legs grub kyis 'dul ba rim pa phye ba las gsungs pa bzhin no/ /zhes dang / bya spyod pa rigs lnga'i sdom gzung byed mi dgos te/ slob dpon gyi dbang med pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas pad+ma lcags kyu la sogs rgya gar ba kha cig dang / bod kha cig gis gdugs dkar dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu la sogs kyi skabs su rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byas 'dug pa 'di ma dag pa chen po yin no/ /sangs rgyas gsang ba dang byang chub mchog gis kyang bya spyod la skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub kyi sems 'dzin pa sngon du gtong ba tsam ma gtogs pa rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ma mdzad do/

/zhes shar chen thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgya mtshos gsungs pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya mi dgos so/ /sa ma ye hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nas/ spyan rgyas pa ut+pa la'i bsung gi tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i gong sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs bzhin/ rang gi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ zhes snying khar rdo rje bzhag su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ bcom ldan 'das mas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag par bsams la/ deng khyed lha mo dang ri khrod ma rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas gdugs dkar mo'i sems bskyed par bya yi/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang gdugs dkar can dang ri khrod ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur la/ dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang gdugs dkar can mas byin rlabs las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsum brjod/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo༞ nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha mo'i rtsa zhal nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dpag med mched rang gi rtsa zhal la thim/ g.yas zhal nas rin po che'i rigs dpag med mched rang gi g.yas zhal la thim/ g.yon zhal nas pad+ma'i rigs dpag med mched rang gi g.yon zhal la thim/

rgyab zhal nas las kyi rigs dpag med mched rang gi rgyab zhal la thim/ steng zhal nas khro bo'i rigs dpag med mched rang gi steng zhal la thim/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag med spyan drangs rang gi lus la thim par gyur/ a na le༞ mang du brjod rol mo bya/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod shar sgo nas/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas me tog phul/ pra ti gṛh+ṇa swa mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la༞ zhes mgo la bcings/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ zhes gdong g.yogs bkrol la dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bstan/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum ltar mthong bar gyur/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o/ /gdugs dkar can gyi dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir rdo rje can/ /de ltar yon tan kun 'byung ba/ /de bzhin bdag la dngos stsol cig gsum/ bum pa'i lha rnams kyi sku lus kyi cha las ye shes kyi chu rgyun babs/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ dus gsum bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku/ nas/ rdo rje mkhar rnams 'joms pa mo/ /drag po lha rnams thams cad kyis/ /bdag la mngon par dbang bskur gsol/ /zhi ba lha rnams kyis mchod ma/ nas/ phyag rgya'i tshogs de dag thams cad kyis/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur gsol/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bhai ra bhai ra/ sau me sau me/ sarba bud+dha a tiṣ+ṭha na a tiṣ+ṭhi te sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇi ṣa sid+dhi ta pa tre hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes pas gtso mo bcom ldan 'das ma'i/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha bdag la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ oṃ hūm̐ ṣ+ṭoṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha badz+ra bdag la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/

oṃ badz+ra pā ni hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇi ṣa a na a wa lo ki te mur+dha ni te dzo rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ pad+ma dz+wa la dz+wa la dha ka dha ka dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bin+dha bin+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ karma sarba/ ta thā ga tā+oṣ+ṇi ṣa sid+dhi ta pa tre hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes 'khor rnams kyi dbang bskur/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+mo rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu'i zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar ston pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /gtso mos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ gsum/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ nas/ yongs su gang ba 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo tha mi dad pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing chu dbang gnang ba'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /i dam gu ru maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyis slob mar gzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /gsum brjod/ dbang gi lhan thabs so/ /mjug chog ni mchod pa rnams/ gsar du bshams pa'am yang na kha gsos bsangs sbyangs pas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā re ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ༞ gyi gnas su/ pad+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhūpe/

ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ shap+ta/ rnams bcug go /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā re rū pa pu dzi te āḥ rū pa'i gnas su/ shap+ta/ ghan+dhe/ ra s+ya/ par+sh+ya/ rnams bcug oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa/ nas/ sa pa ri wā re sap+ta rat+na badz+ra pū dze te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ nas/ sa pa ri wā re aṣ+ṭa mang ga la grā bh+yaḥpu dze te aḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can nas/ bdag nyid gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir gyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag dpal ldan bla ma gong ma zhi bar gshegs pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs zag med kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gtso mdzad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe brtan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dam tshig nyams chag thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mtho ris dang / thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi bar du gcod pa dang mi dge ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gnas skabs su yang las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i gnod pa dang /

sdug bsngal gyi bye brag gdon chen po bco brgyad dang / bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang / log 'dren dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / byad stems dang / pha rol gyi rig sngags las gyur pa'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ me dang chu dang / sa g.yo ba la sogs pa 'byung ba las gyur pa'i gnod pa dang / lo nyes dang / dgra'i gnod pa la sogs pa 'jigs pa chen po bcu drug dang / mu ge dang / mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang / dbul zhing phongs pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang / de dag gi rgyud bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sngon gyi las las gyur kyang rung / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur kyang rung ste phyi nang gi nye bar 'tshe ba dang / lus sems la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs dang nad la sogs pa/ lus kyi sdug bsngal ba dang / sems yid mi bde ba dang / skal pa ngan pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa dang / lus dang / srog dang / longs spyod dang / skal pa dang / dge ba sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba mdzad du gsol/ mdor na bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs su yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi nas 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub mtha' dag 'grub pa dang / mthar thug sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa zhi nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ spro na bla ma'i brtan bzhugs 'dod gsol tshigs bcad sogs byed na 'dir bya'o/ /bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi nas/ bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnams so so'i skye bor gyur pas sems nyon mongs pa can du gyur nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa nyon mongs pa dang 'dres shing /

bag med par gyur nas/ rnal 'byor pa la dbang ma thob pas/ sems bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / snyigs ma lnga'i dus kyi dbang gis nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang / mchod rdzas med cing ngan pa dang / brjed ngas pa dang / shes bzhin ma yin pa'i dbang du gyur nas cho ga lhag pa dang / chad pa dang / ser sna'i dbang gis mchod pa ngan cing chung ba dang / gti mug gi dbang gis rgyud sde nas 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa'i 'khrul zhing nongs pa thams cad bzod par bzhes nas bdag cag gis lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pa la ya/ badz+ra satwa te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shrī ya/ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+ra'i bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa aḥ gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid bstsal ba/ /de kun 'phags mas bzod par mdzod/ /lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang / /cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang / /bdag gi brjed ngas ci mchis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /ser sna'i dbang gyur mi mkhas pas/ /mchod pa ngan zhing bsham nyes pa/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pas/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /bag med spyod pa ma dag pas/ /rgyud las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/ /ma lcogs 'khrul pa ci mchis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang / /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de kun 'phags mas bzod par mdzod/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / yang dag par ldan pa'i bde ba dang yid bde ba nyid kyis mi chog sangs rgyas su tshe 'di nyid la gyur cig bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol/ /bdag dang 'gro la༞ nas/ de srid bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa sa tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muṃḥ bsdu rgya phyir bstan/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ rang dam tshig par gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur tu bdag /'phags ma sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos kyi nyi ma rgyas pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi nas/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnams 'phel ba/ /rtag tu dpal gnas༞ dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs dug lngas gdung ba'i dgra zhi nas/ /rtag tu dpal gnas༞ tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs dang / /phan mdzad lha yi byin rlabs gnas gyur te/ /dge legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te/

/sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod pa dag /skye dgu kun la rtag tu byams byed pas/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /'dir ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ /rtag tu bden par gsungs shing brdzun med pa/ /bden pa de yis deng 'dir bde legs shog /deng 'dir 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bkra shis dang bde legs chen pos khyab par gyur cig dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ zhag gis bar ma chod par nyi ma de la cho ga bskyar nas byed na/ gso sbyong bzhag oṃ dus gsum bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku/ nas bzung / bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor 'degs mi 'degs 'dam kha mdzad pa'i shugs kyis/ mdun bskyed kyang 'degs mi 'degs 'dam kha yin pas 'degs na mdun bskyed la oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sogs sbyar ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur de nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs nas/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ zhes mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa bstims pa'i rjes su/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang thugs kha'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥnas bkra shis kyi bar bya/ mdun bskyed mi 'degs na/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre༞ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs nas bkra shis kyi bar sngar bzhin/ gshegs gsol gyi dus dge rtsa bsngo ba'i sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol yan bya/ yig brgya bzlas shing rol mo dang bcas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum bya/

shar sgo nas/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /nas/ slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥbadag mdun gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ chos thams cad ni skye ba med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni 'gag pa med pa'o/ /a kā ro༞ bzla zhing rdo rjes/ shar/ byang / nub/ lho/ tshangs thig gi lam nas ri mo bya/ lha mtshan rnams byang sgo nas bzung / mas rim gyis me long g.ya' dag pa'i steng du bsdus/ gtso mo'i mtshan ma rang gi spyi bor bzhag me long g.ya' dag pa stong nyid mtshon/ de'i steng du lha mtshan bsdu ba/ lha thams cad stong pa nyid du thim par mtshon zhes gsungs so/ /thig rjes rnams phyi la mi mngon par byas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐/ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas phur bu rnams 'og steng / byang shar nas/ shar gyi bar mas rim gyis bton/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sa dha ni swāhā/ zhes bzlas pa'i 'og mas phur bu'i dbal dang / phur khung la gtor/ phur bu'i lha rnams rang gi lag gi rdo rje la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bgegs rnams kyi rma dang zug rngu zhi nas sgrib pa dag te rang rang gi zhing du sangs rgyas par gyur/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ ye dharmā༞ gsum gyis me tog bsgrubs shing byin gyis brlabs/ rdul tshon rnams byin nam mchod pa dang bcas pas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor/ rjes bsngo smon bkra shis kyis mtha' brten bya'o/ /gal te sgrub mchod nyi ma dril nas mdzad na/ sang gso sbyong byas rjes/ oṃ dus gsum bde gshegs nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar byas rjes oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si ta sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/

de nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs nas/ brtan bzhugs bkra shis kyi bar sngar bzhin dang / gshegs gsol gyi dus/ sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol nas/ bkra shis kyi bar sngar bzhin bya'o/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i ngag 'don 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bris/ oṃ a si tā na lārka pra bhā s+phu ṭa/ bi ka si tā/ ta pa tre/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ khā da khā da/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bin+dha bin+dha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo gha phaṭa/ a pra ti ha da phaṭa/ ba da ra phaṭa/ pra taṃ gi ri ti phaṭa/ a su ra bi dra ba ka phaṭa/ sarba de be bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba nā ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba a su re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ma ru tse bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ga ru ḍe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba gan+dha rbe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kin+na re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ma ho ra ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba yak+ṣe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba rāk+ṣa se bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pra te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pi shā tse bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba bhu te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kum+bhaṇ+ḍe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pu ta ne bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ka ṭa pu ta ne bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba skan+de bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba un+mā de bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ts+tsha ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba a pasma re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba o stā ra ke bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba durli ghi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba duṣ+p+re k+ṣi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba dz+wa re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kri t+ya karma ka kho dhe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ki ra ṇe be tā ḍa bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tsits+tsha pre ṣa ka dush+tsarga te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba dur+bhuk+te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba tīr+the ke bh+yaḥ sarba shra ma ṇe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba bid+yā dha re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ dza ya ka ra ma dhu ka ra sarba ar+tha sā dha ke bh+yaḥphaṭa/ bid+ya tsa re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tsa tur+bha gi nī ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kau ma ri ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ bid+ya ra dzi ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ma hā pra t+yaṃ gi re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ badz+ra badz+ra shrī kha la yā pra t+yaṃ gi rā dza ya phaṭa/

ma hā kā lā ya mā tri ga ṇa/ na ma skṛ tā ya phaṭa/ biṣ+ṇa nī ye phaṭa/ brah+ma ṇi ye phaṭa/ ag+nī ye phaṭa/ ma hā kā lī ye phaṭa/ kā la ṇi ye phaṭa/ in+d+ra ye phaṭa/ rau trī ye phaṭa/ kau ma rī ye phaṭa/ bā ra hī ye phaṭa/ tsa mu ṇi ye phaṭa/ rā trī ye phaṭa/ ka la rā trī ye phaṭa/ ya ma daṇ+ḍi ye phaṭa/ ka pā lī ye phaṭa/ adhi muk+ti sh+ma sha na ba si ni ye phaṭa/ phyir bzlog chung ba las byung ba zha lu lo chen gyis zhus dag mdzad pa ltar bris/ mchog grub dang mi gcig pa snang ngo / /bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 62 kun dga' blo gros/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi chog khrid 'khrul med/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 61
